name: Working handset assembly
summary: Representative smartphone architecture; not a model-specific bill of materials.
steps: Populate boards: Print solder paste, place chips and passive components, reflow solder; inspect joints. Check: Continuity, power rails, optical and hidden-joint inspection.
Fit modules: Install board, display, cameras, speaker, antennas, flex cables and battery in a compatible frame. Check: All modules seated; cables clear of screw and pinch points.
Close chassis: Fasten covers; bond glass and fit seals where the chosen design requires them. Check: Mechanical fit; leak test if water resistance is a target.
Load & test: Load boot code, firmware and operating system; calibrate and test the assembled device. Check: Boot, charge, touch, camera, sound, sensors and a radio connection.
Prepare and load hardware-matched boot code, firmware, drivers and operating system using an earlier computing platform.
gaps: Cellular calls also require compatible network infrastructure.
Exact grades, quantities, operating parameters, tolerances and complete making dependencies are not finalized.
External cell towers, outlets and standard external charger manufacture are excluded by latest user clarification; handset charge interface and network interoperability remain required.
High-end performance target, model-specific architecture, supported bands/protocols, identity provisioning, software source/toolchain and driver compatibility remain unchosen.
requirements_status: Proposed; unlinked pending central dependency review

name: Speaker
summary: Other speakers may use aluminium or copper-clad aluminium; copper is the chosen route.
steps: Make motor: Assemble permanent magnet and soft-magnetic pole pieces around a coil gap. Check: Field and gap conform to the selected speaker design.
Attach coil: Bond the wound coil to the diaphragm and its compliant suspension. Check: Assembly remains flexible; coil attachment stays secure.
Center & seal: Center the moving assembly in the gap; join it to the frame and acoustic enclosure. Check: Free movement without rubbing; intended air paths preserved.
Connect & test: Terminate leads and sweep an audio signal through the driver. Check: Response, impedance, distortion and rub/buzz within chosen targets.
gaps: A voice coil alone is insufficient: magnet, membrane and air paths remain essential.
Exact grades, quantities, operating parameters, tolerances and complete making dependencies are not finalized.
requirements_status: Proposed; unlinked pending central dependency review

name: Copper voice coil
summary: Exact turn count, diameter and resistance await a selected speaker design.
steps: Set form: Prepare a mandrel matching the required coil shape. Check: Shape and winding space match the design.
Wind: Lay insulated turns with controlled tension and a repeatable turn count. Check: No crossed turns or damaged insulation.
Bond & release: Activate a bonding overcoat or resin, then release the stable coil from the mandrel. Check: Coil holds shape without excess moving mass.
Terminate & check: Prepare the wire ends and attach compliant leads or contacts. Check: Continuity, dimensions and absence of turn shorts.
gaps: Wire resistance and coil mass must match the speaker and amplifier.
Exact grades, quantities, operating parameters, tolerances and complete making dependencies are not finalized.
requirements_status: Proposed; unlinked pending central dependency review

name: Insulated wire
summary: Resin chemistry, process settings and acceptance limits are still unexpanded.
steps: Clean & soften: Clean the conductor and anneal it before coating. Check: Soft wire with a clean, coating-compatible surface.
Apply coats: Apply repeated thin layers of insulating varnish. Check: Continuous coverage without excessive coil bulk.
Cure: Pass coated wire through a controlled curing process; repeat for the required build. Check: Insulation adheres and survives bending.
Spool & test: Apply winding lubricant, control take-up tension and test the spool. Check: Insulation integrity, flexibility and continuous conductor.
gaps: Ordinary paint or a thick sleeve will not substitute at the same scale.
Exact grades, quantities, operating parameters, tolerances and complete making dependencies are not finalized.
requirements_status: Proposed; unlinked pending central dependency review

name: Fine copper wire
summary: No wire gauge is fixed yet; present-day manufacturers use carbide and diamond dies.
steps: Prepare feed: Prepare rod and a pointed end that can enter the first die. Check: End can be gripped; feed is free of major defects.
Draw in stages: Pull through progressively smaller dies using capstans and lubrication. Check: Wire becomes thinner and longer without breaks.
Restore ductility: Use appropriate annealing where the process needs softness restored. Check: Wire remains drawable and windable.
Finish & gauge: Finish to the selected diameter; verify uniformity and spool for coating. Check: Continuous fine wire within the chosen design tolerances.
gaps: A coarse steel drawplate is a starting tool; fine wire requires more precise dies.
Exact grades, quantities, operating parameters, tolerances and complete making dependencies are not finalized.
requirements_status: Proposed; unlinked pending central dependency review

name: Copper rod
summary: Small-batch cast/forged stock is a proposed bootstrap substitute for an industrial rod mill.
steps: Melt: Melt a controlled batch of refined copper. Check: Usable melt without unwanted inclusions.
Cast stock: Cast a sound bar or billet in a suitable mould. Check: No serious porosity or cracking.
Work to rod: Forge or roll into rod; soften as needed between reductions. Check: Straight, consistent feedstock for drawing.
Inspect & clean: Remove surface scale and reject defective stock. Check: Stock passes subsequent trial drawing.
gaps: Casting shape is easier than controlling purity and internal defects.
Exact grades, quantities, operating parameters, tolerances and complete making dependencies are not finalized.
requirements_status: Proposed; unlinked pending central dependency review

name: Refined copper
summary: Refining may be bypassed only if the recovered metal passes the actual wiremaking requirements.
steps: Prepare anode: Clean and consolidate recovered copper into an anode. Check: Anode suitable for controlled dissolution.
Build cell: Arrange anode and starter cathode in a copper-salt acidic electrolyte. Check: Stable cell with no electrode short.
Transfer copper: Apply DC so copper dissolves from the anode and deposits on the cathode. Check: Copper deposit forms without trapping excessive impurities.
Recover & verify: Recover and clean the deposit; check material quality before remelting. Check: Purity and drawability sufficient for the wire route.
gaps: DC power and chemical production are additional unfinished branches.
Exact grades, quantities, operating parameters, tolerances and complete making dependencies are not finalized.
requirements_status: Proposed; unlinked pending central dependency review

name: Native copper recovery
summary: Native copper avoids ore reduction; it does not guarantee wiremaking purity.
steps: Locate metal: Find a deposit containing metallic copper rather than merely copper-bearing minerals. Check: Fresh material shows metallic, malleable copper.
Expose & break: Use stone tools to expose and break copper-bearing rock. Check: Recoverable metal separated from host rock.
Sort & recover: Hand-sort and mechanically free promising pieces. Check: Concentrated metallic copper feedstock.
Clean & qualify: Clean recovered pieces and retain material for later assay or refining. Check: Metal supply adequate for the next stage.
gaps: This route depends on suitable geography; oxide and sulfide ores need different processes.
Exact grades, quantities, operating parameters, tolerances and complete making dependencies are not finalized.
requirements_status: Proposed; unlinked pending central dependency review

summary: Five distinct tools separate resistance/continuity, audio generation/drive, supplied energy and acoustic measurement. Each needs its own making and calibration route.

Check coil continuity and DC resistance.
Supply controlled audio signal through a powered amplifier.

Rectify/regulate/protect output as the load requires.
Verify voltage/current, waveform, regulation and loaded capacity.

summary: Accessible Great Orme-inspired oxide-ore extraction is separate from native-metal recovery and industrial sulfide processing.
steps: Identify chemistry and geology beyond color.
Expose and separate accessible mineral-bearing pieces using suitable early tools.
Sort ore and rejects; stop extraction at ore.

Recover and qualify material; manage electrolyte and residues.

summary: Lithography is one repeated wafer-patterning process; an exposure apparatus and its supporting fab are distinct manufacturing requirements.
steps: Choose the target chip capability and supported process level.
Prepare wafer/resist/mask and controlled processing environment.
Expose, develop and inspect the pattern.
Repeat process-specific deposition/patterning/etch/doping/interconnect layers.
Package and test; build and qualify every enabling machine separately.
